```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

library(yaml) 
news_list <- read_yaml("_data/news.yml")
 
# Open main outer grid container
cat("::: {.grid}\n\n")

for (i in seq_along(news_list)) {
  item <- news_list[[i]] 
  
  cat("::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}\n\n")
  cat("::: {.card .border-0 .h-100}\n\n")
  
  # Render photos inside an inner grid if present
  if (!is.null(item$photos) && length(item$photos) > 0) {
    n_photos <- length(item$photos)
    
    # 1. Choose layout column width based on photo count
    col_class <- if (n_photos == 2) "g-col-6" else if (n_photos == 3) "g-col-4" else "g-col-12"
    
    # 2. Choose image CSS class (single photo vs multi-photo)
    img_class <- if (n_photos == 1) "horizontal-photo-image" else "photo-image"
    
    cat('::: {.grid style="--bs-gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 0.75rem 0 0.75rem;"}\n\n')

    for (p in item$photos) {
      cat(sprintf('::: {.%s}\n\n', col_class))
      cat(sprintf('![](%s){.%s}\n\n', p$image, img_class))
      if (!is.null(p$caption) && nchar(p$caption) > 0) {
        cat(sprintf('<div class="mt-1"><mark>%s</mark></div>\n\n', p$caption))
      }
      cat(':::\n\n')
    } 
    
    cat(':::\n\n')
  }
  
  # Render Date and Text Body
  cat('::: {.card-body .px-3 .pt-2}\n\n')
  cat(sprintf('<small class="text-muted d-block mb-1">%s</small>\n\n', item$date))
  cat(sprintf('%s\n\n', item$text))
  cat(':::\n\n')
  
  cat(":::\n\n")
  cat(":::\n\n")
}

# Close main outer grid container
cat(":::\n\n")
```
